The canonical command count — distinct registered top-level names (`specy-road version` not counted) minus the names tests/parity/command_map.yaml retires — is at most 61, and the test prints the name set: the 74 top-level names registered at claim plus the 2 new groups (`specy-road milestone`, `specy-road planning`) minus the 15 retired names, which are the 14 that M16.4.1, M16.4.2, M16.4.3 and this leaf retire (`specy-road registry-prune`, `specy-road branches`, `specy-road refresh-stubs`, `specy-road refresh-schemas`, `specy-road refresh-profiles`, `specy-road handoff`, `specy-road review-packet`, `specy-road lessons`, `specy-road start-milestone-session`, `specy-road reconcile-milestone-status`, `specy-road open-milestone-pr`, `specy-road scaffold-planning`, `specy-road author-approach`, `specy-road archive-node`) plus `specy-road update`, renamed to `specy-road self-update` (net zero). A top-level name is retired only by a top-level command_map row with no options that moves it to a different command: its old is `specy-road NAME` and its new is neither that command nor under it; flag rows and subcommand rows retire nothing, so `specy-road branches` and `specy-road handoff` are retired by their top-level rows (`specy-road branches` -> `specy-road doctor --prune --kind`, `specy-road handoff` -> `specy-road review status`).
